description: Finds products on 1688 (China’s wholesale market) and prices them: each result has a reference, a translated title, a photo and the price per piece including order fees, with the quantity that price is for. Useful when they want to buy or resell products from China, find products on 1688, or know what a product costs to buy, even under a given price or before reselling it on Amazon. Give ONE of: `query` (product words, any language), `photo_urls` (up to 5 public image addresses you found or were shown), `last_photo` (the photo they sent to Rabbit) or `audience` (a niche or a group of buyers, e.g. “dog owners”, “over 40s”). With nothing to search yet, `photo_upload_link: true` gives them a link to drop a photo. A 1688 link they pasted: product_page with `link`. Nothing is paid in the conversation: they order and pay on Rabbit’s order page (`order`); shipping is paid after weighing.

audience.description: A niche or a group of buyers, in their words.

count.description: With `query`: how many products (5 if omitted).

country.description: The country, as a two-letter code (US, FR, GB…); their account’s if omitted.

last_photo.description: true: the last photo they sent to Rabbit (upload link, Rabbit app or Chrome extension), within two hours.

live.description: With `query`: true searches 1688 live, beyond Rabbit’s catalogue (uses one search of their monthly quota). When they want more or newer results.

max_price_per_piece.description: With `audience`: the highest price per piece they accept, in their account’s currency (optional).

photo_upload_link.description: true: a single-use link where they drop a photo of the product; then call again with `last_photo: true`. Also for an image attached in the conversation, which has no public address.

photo_urls.description: Up to 5 https addresses of images of the product. One search per photo.

query.description: The product, in a few words (“insulated steel bottle”).

name: find_products
title: Find products on 1688
